matchedRecords.name: Peconic River River Road to Edwards Avenue public paddling access
matchedRecords.method: NYSDEC lists River Road East, River Road West, and the Mill Road at Edwards Avenue hand-launch contexts with map coordinates, carry/parking notes, and electric-motor restrictions. The Peconic River Blueway map independently identifies the upper launch sequence; stored points follow the state map anchors and remain subject to current permit, gate, carry, waterline, and dam-status confirmation.

matchedRecords.name: Colorado Arkansas Headwaters Granite to Buena Vista access anchors
matchedRecords.method: Colorado Parks and Wildlife identifies Granite Boat Chute and Buena Vista Whitewater Park as public Arkansas Headwaters Recreation Area river-access sites. Preserve the stored coordinates as named access-area anchors and verify the marked ramp/slide, carry, parking, fees, and current water entry before launch.

controls.coordinateText: CPW/AHRA public Granite Boat Chute river-access anchor; verify the boat slide, portage trail, parking, and water entry.
